why_this_exists: The adjudication made this a precondition of touching the annotation: an annotation read in many places cannot be narrowed until it is known who reads it. Each entry records where the read happens, what it reads, and -- the column that matters -- what changes for that reader when a composition that used to be a formula becomes a text line instead.
scope: every site outside StylesAndFormulas itself that reads the pdf_formula member of a composition, or a PdfFormula reached through one. Collected from the tree at 6ea160d.
direction_of_the_change: this batch's repair only ever turns formula into text; it never turns text into formula. So each row is read as: what does this consumer do differently when it sees one fewer formula.

sites.reads: treats a formula composition as permitted and continues, so an all-formula paragraph reads as placeholder only
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the paragraph stops being all-formula and is no longer refused. THIS IS THE INTENDED EFFECT for exposure class (i): 43 compositions in 29 paragraphs.

sites.reads: collects a formula's characters into the cid ratio
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: none. The same characters are collected through the pdf_line branch instead; the ratio is over the same set.

sites.reads: each formula composition becomes a {vN} placeholder in the request and is restored from it in the reply
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the words go into the request as words instead of as placeholders. THIS IS THE INTENDED EFFECT for exposure class (ii): 11 compositions in 3 paragraphs. It also removes the inter-placeholder space loss recorded in b11.2 section 4.4.

sites.reads: branches on the composition kind when building text and when writing a placeholder's formula back
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the composition is assembled through the line branch; write-back has one less formula to restore

sites.reads: a formula becomes one indivisible typesetting unit with its own scaling and offset rules, and its curves and forms are handed to the page rather than the paragraph
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the characters are typeset as text: they may be broken across lines, and they take the paragraph's font handling instead of being kept as-is. This is the largest behavioural change of the repair and the reason T4 measures conservation.

sites.in: composition length, character collection, height, first and last character, space insertion, box
sites.reads: the formula's box and characters in each of these measurements
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: each measurement takes the line branch; the same characters and boxes are involved, so the measured quantities are unchanged in kind

sites.reads: the formula's characters
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the same characters are reached through the line branch

sites.reads: the formula's characters
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: runs before StylesAndFormulas in the pipeline order, so it does not see this batch's change at all

sites.reads: a formula is ATOMIC: a line split may not cut it
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the composition becomes SPLITTABLE, so line splitting may now cut where it previously could not. This is how the masthead heading comes to stand as its own paragraph, and the repair changes what that paragraph contains.

sites.reads: a paragraph holding a formula is not movable, because typesetting hands the formula's artwork to the page and the paragraph cannot take it along
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: a paragraph that held only this formula becomes movable, so column reflow may now move it. Conservation in T4 must therefore include the reflow report.

sites.in: composition_kind not in SPLITTABLE disqualifies the group
sites.reads: a formula member disqualifies its stitch group
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: groups that were disqualified may now stitch

sites.in: median character size, and the head/tail kinds of a two-composition paragraph
sites.reads: the formula as a character holder, and its kind when deciding an initial
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the median is over the same characters; the head/tail kind changes, so a paragraph whose initial was grouped into a formula is now read through the style-run path

sites.reads: the kind when deciding whether a parenthesis run may be removed
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: one more composition becomes eligible for the pass

sites.reads: the formula's characters
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the same characters are reached through another branch

sites.reads: the formula as one of the holders it walks
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the same characters are reached through another holder

sites.reads: the formula as one of the holders it writes back through
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the same characters are reached through another holder

sites.reads: nothing; the file names the mechanism in a comment and does not branch on it
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: none in code. The detector's counts do change, because the paragraphs now carry translated text; that is measured in T4.

sites.in: character, form and curve collection when writing the page
sites.reads: a formula's characters, its pdf_form and its pdf_curve
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: a PdfLine carries no pdf_form and no pdf_curve. Any drawing that was attached to the formula would no longer be emitted, so the repair must not be applied to a composition that carries artwork. This is the one consumer that can lose something, and it is why the repair's condition is checked against compositions that hold characters only.

sites.reads: the formula's box and characters to draw debug rectangles
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: one fewer formula rectangle in debug output; no effect on the produced document

sites.in: a standalone tool reading the JSON form
sites.reads: the pdf_formula key of a serialised composition
sites.effect_of_one_fewer_formula: the tool sees one fewer formula; it is not part of the pipeline

the_one_that_can_lose_something: pdf_creater.py:866-867 and 903-904. PdfLine has no pdf_form and no pdf_curve member, so a formula that carries artwork must not be turned into a line. The repair is therefore conditioned on compositions whose formula carries characters only, and the gate asserts it.
